title: Mag-Bind® Total RNA 96 Kit
author: Opentrons (verified)
materials: User is instructed to mix samples on heater-shaker.
Elution solution added to sample and mixed
dnase1 added to sample and mixed
Stop solution added to sample and mixed

steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Set the following parameters in the OT‑2 script: Number of samples (1‑96, multiple of 8), Deepwell type, Reservoir type, Starting volume (µL), Binding buffer volume (µL), three Wash volumes (µL) plus optional fourth wash, Elution volume (µL), Settling time (7 min), Mag Deck Generation (GEN1 or GEN2), Park Tips option, Track Tips option, Flash on tip‑out option, and P300 multi‑channel pipette mount.

steps.title: Mix binding buffer
steps.instruction: Thoroughly vortex or pipette‑mix the binding buffer to ensure homogeneity before use.

steps.title: Add binding buffer to samples
steps.instruction: Dispense the specified binding buffer volume into each sample well containing the starting volume of sample.

steps.title: Mix binding buffer with samples
steps.instruction: Mix each well to combine the binding buffer and sample (e.g., pipette up/down or shake).

steps.title: Shake samples on heater‑shaker
steps.instruction: Place the plate on a heater‑shaker and mix for the recommended time (if any).

steps.title: Engage magnet and settle
steps.instruction: Activate the magnetic module and allow the beads to collect for the specified settling time (7 minutes).

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard the supernatant without disturbing the magnetic bead pellet.

steps.title: Wash with buffer 1
steps.instruction: Add wash buffer 1 (first wash volume) to the beads and mix.

steps.title: Engage magnet and wait
steps.instruction: Re‑engage the magnetic module and wait 7 minutes for bead separation.

steps.title: Remove supernatant after wash 1
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard the supernatant from wash 1.

steps.title: Disengage magnet
steps.instruction: Turn off the magnetic module before the next wash.

steps.title: Wash with buffer 2
steps.instruction: Perform a second wash using wash buffer 2.

substeps.instruction: Add wash buffer 2 to the beads

steps.title: Add elution solution and mix
steps.instruction: Dispense the elution volume into the bead pellet and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Add DNase I and mix
steps.instruction: Add the specified amount of DNase I to the eluate and mix.

steps.title: Add stop solution and mix
steps.instruction: Add the stop solution to the reaction and mix.

steps.title: Engage magnet and remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module, wait the settling time, then remove the supernatant containing DNase I and stop solution.

steps.title: Wash with buffers 3 and 4
steps.instruction: Perform two additional washes using wash buffers 3 and 4.

substeps.instruction: Add wash buffer 3, mix, engage magnet, wait 7 minutes, remove supernatant, disengage magnet
Add wash buffer 4, mix, engage magnet, wait 7 minutes, remove supernatant, disengage magnet

steps.title: Incubate after final wash
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate for 7 minutes (e.g., on heater‑shaker).

steps.title: Second elution
steps.instruction: Add fresh elution solution (elution volume) to the beads and mix.

steps.title: Transfer eluate to aluminum block
steps.instruction: Dispense the final eluate into an aluminum block for downstream processing.
